annotation.justification: The clause 'The endpoint SHOULD continue to do so as more requests or pushes arrive.' refers to the cancellation of requests or pushes as described in the previous clause. The language is clear in that it indicates continuation of the same behavior (cancelling requests/pushes) as new ones arrive. The use of 'SHOULD' allows discretion but does not introduce ambiguity in the required behavior. There is no conflicting or missing constraint that would lead to multiple materially different implementations.
